polilinha.dica: Creates a 2D polyline: connected straight segments (PL)

circulo.dica: Creates a circle: center and radius (C)

inserir.dica: Inserts a block from the drawing (I)

retangulo.dica: Creates a rectangle from two corners (REC)

elipse.dica: Creates an ellipse: center, axis, other semi-axis (EL)

hachura.dica: Hatches a closed boundary: click inside it (H)

3dface.dica: Creates a 3 or 4-point planar face in 3D space (3DFACE)

m3d_revolucao.dica: Revolves a 2D profile around an axis (REVOLVE)

m3d_varredura.dica: Sweeps a profile along a 3D path (SWEEP)

m3d_uniao3d.dica: Unions 3D solids into a single body (UNION)

m3d_mover3d.dica: Moves objects along 3D axes X, Y, Z (3DMOVE)

elevacao.dica: Sets the active work plane Z elevation (ELEV)

mover.dica: Moves objects: base point and destination (M)

estender.clique: EXTEND Click near the end to extend (Enter ends):
estender.semLimite: There is no shape in the way of this end.
estender.naoSuporta: Only lines, arcs and open straight-segment polylines can be extended.

aparar.dica: Trims the clicked part between cuts (TR)

copiar.dica: Copies objects, as many times as you like (CO)

deslocar.dica: Parallel copy at the given distance (O)

estender.dica: Extends the clicked end to the next shape (EX)

concordancia.dica: Fillets two lines with a radius (F)

matriz.dica: Copies in a grid: rows, columns and spacing (AR)

cota.dica: Linear dimension: two points and the line position (DLI)

cota_alinhada.dica: Measures the true distance between two points, with a parallel line (DAL)

cota_raio.dica: Dimensions the radius of a circle or arc (DRA)

cota_diametro.dica: Dimensions the diameter of a circle or arc (DDI)

tabela.dica: Table: grid only, with rows and columns (TB)

tornar_atual.dica: Makes the clicked object's layer current (LAYMCUR)

igualar_camada.dica: Moves objects to another object's layer (LAYMCH)

criar_bloco.dica: Creates a block from the selected objects (B)

igualar_propriedades.dica: Copies layer, color, linetype and lineweight from one object to others (MA)

agrupar.dica: Groups objects (clicking one selects the group); again, ungroups (G)

folha_inserir.dica: Inserts the title frame and block at the chosen scale

folha_escala.dica: Changes the sheet scale or fits it to the drawing

folha_carimbo.dica: Edits client, title, number and revision of the sheet's title block

hachura_padrao.dica: Picks the hatch pattern: concrete, earth, sand, brick…

contar.dica: Click an object: selects every object equal to it and tells how many there are (CNT)

anot_cota.dica: Linear dimension: two points and line position (COT)

anot_cota_alinhada.dica: Measures real distance between two points (CAL)

anot_cota_raio.dica: Dimensions radius of a circle or arc (CRA)

anot_cota_diametro.dica: Dimensions diameter of a circle or arc (CDI)

anot_chamada.dica: Leader line with arrow and text (CH)

anot_tabela.dica: Table: grid of rows and columns (TAB)

anot_contar.dica: Click an object: selects all identical objects (CNT)

ribbon.embreve: This tab will be filled in later.

comando.anguloTravado: Direction locked at {graus}°: type the distance (or click).

memoria.indisponivel: Measurement unavailable (installed app on Linux only).

total.dica: Memory of all the app's processes, added up

principal.dica: The main process: the engine and the files

webview.dica: The interface process: the drawing on screen and JavaScript

pico.dica: The highest use since the app opened (VmHWM)

cpu.dica: The app tree's processor use, in % of one core (the ceiling is 100 % × {nucleos} cores)

gpu.dica: How much of the time the graphics card was busy (whole system, not just the app)

vram.dica: Graphics card memory in use on the system

overlay.vazio: No log recorded or matching the filter.

projetos.vazio: No project folders yet. Add the folder where you keep your drawings.

projetos.semDesenhos: There are no .dxf or .fcdz drawings in this folder.

confirmar.corpo: The drawing "{nome}" has changes that were not saved.

erro.mudouNoDisco: "{nome}" changed on disk, but there are unsaved changes here. Save to overwrite it, or reopen it to see the disk version.
erro.motorDesatualizado: The app engine is out of date with the interface. Close the app and start it again (npm run app:dev) so it recompiles.

aviso.entidadesIgnoradas: {n} object(s) were left out of the drawing (not supported yet): {tipos}.
aviso.dentroDeBlocos: {n} object(s) inside blocks were left out (not supported yet): {tipos}.
aviso.hachuraNaoGravada: {n} hatch(es) were not saved to the DXF (area with an island, or too much detail). Save as .fcdz to keep them.
aviso.corAproximada: {n} color(s) were approximated to the DXF color table (ACI).
aviso.espessuraNaoGravada: {n} lineweight(s) (layer or object) were not saved: the DXF written today (R12) has no lineweight. Save as .fcdz to keep them.
aviso.hachuraDecomposta: {n} hatch(es) were saved as lines and triangles: the DXF written today (R12) has no hatch. Save as .fcdz to keep true hatches.
aviso.nuvemCarregada: Point cloud loaded: {pontos} points processed, {curvas} contour lines generated.

fonte.dica: Menus, panels and the command line.

segundoPlano.rotulo: Paint the drawing in the background
segundoPlano.dica: Decodes and paints the drawing in a Worker, off the main thread, so the mouse does not stall while a heavy drawing is painted. Takes effect when the app is reopened. Turn it off if the drawing does not appear.

textoNoMovimento.rotulo: Full text while zooming and panning
textoNoMovimento.dica: Redraws text on every zoom and pan frame (sharp, but stutters in drawings with lots of text). Off (default), the text follows the motion by scaling and is redrawn sharp when you stop.

zoomSuave.dica: The mouse wheel and the zoom buttons animate the change instead of jumping. Turn it off for the instant zoom, as in AutoCAD.

snap.dica: The cursor jumps step by step along the grid.

orto.dica: Locks drawing to horizontal and vertical.

osnap.dica: The cursor sticks to endpoints, midpoints and centers.

formato.dica: .dxf opens in any CAD; .fcdz is the native format and keeps everything.

salvamento.nota: FeatherCAD has no account or cloud: the file stays wherever you save it, on your machine.

idioma.nota: The interface reloads when the language changes; save your drawing first.

apelidos.dica: Add the abbreviations you want on the command line, separated by commas.

sobre.texto: FeatherCAD — 2D CAD of the FeatherOffice suite. Everything runs on your machine: no drawing data leaves it.
sobre.monitorDica: Memory, console and metrics of the app, in a separate window.

fps.dica: Shows frames per second and the time of each stage (engine, cursor, paint) at the top of the drawing area. Ctrl+Shift+F also toggles it. seg = straight segments drawn in the frame; txt = texts.

cota.dica: Height of the dimension text, in {unidade}; the arrow follows. Empty = automatic (proportional to the drawing).

orto.dica: Ortho locks drawing to multiples of this angle from the previous point: 90° = horizontal and vertical only; 45° = diagonals too; 60°, 30° and 15° lock to those steps. Also applies when dragging and moving.

mcp.texto: MCP lets an AI (Claude Code, for example) see, measure and draw in this program: it gets an image of the drawing with coordinates, exact measurements, and the drawing as compact text. The server is a separate program, started by the AI client; FeatherCAD opens no network port.
mcp.encontrado: Ready to use. The button checks that it answers.
mcp.naoEncontrado: Not built yet. Run `npm run mcp:build` inside the feathercad folder (the command below already uses the expected path).
mcp.semApp: This window is the browser: the path below is only a template. Replace it with the path of the `feathercad-mcp` program.
mcp.claudeDica: Paste in the terminal to register the server.
mcp.outrosDica: For clients that read an `mcpServers` config file (Claude Desktop, Cursor…).
mcp.testeOk: Working: the program answered and listed {n} tools.
mcp.ferramentasLista: See (image with coordinates), list and measure entities, find closed areas, check gaps, create and edit shapes, layers, hatch, undo, and read/write the drawing as compact text (.fct) using few tokens.
mcp.privacidade: Everything runs on this machine. The server only opens and writes .dxf, .fcdz and .fct files, and never overwrites an existing file unless the AI explicitly asks.

exportar.corpo: Pick the paper, the orientation and which sheets go into the PDF. Each sheet becomes a page.
exportar.semFolhas: The drawing has no sheets (closed rectangles on the FOLHA layer): one page with the whole drawing is exported.
exportar.cores: Keep the screen colors (otherwise black on white)

unidade.corpo: Which unit will this drawing be worked in? It is saved in the file, and the .dxf carries it to other CAD programs.
unidade.dica: Only changes what the numbers mean; objects are not resized.
unidade.semUnidade: This file did not say its unit. Pick the one it uses.
unidade.trocarDepois: You can change it later in Settings. Keys: 1, 2, 3 · Esc cancels.

inserir.corpo: Pick the paper and the scale. The sheet is the drawing's title frame (border, title block, notes and legend); the drawing stays full size and the sheet grows with the scale.
inserir.automatica: Automatic (the smallest scale where the drawing fits)
inserir.divisoria: Dividing line across the middle (two views)

escala.corpo: Change the sheet's scale (it keeps framing the same region) or let the program pick the smallest scale where the whole drawing fits.
escala.semFolhas: The drawing has no sheets yet. Use "Insert sheet".

carimbo.corpo: Change the sheet's title block fields. An empty field goes back to the model's guide text.

contar.clique: COUNT Click an object to count the ones equal to it (Enter ends):
contar.resultado: {n} object(s) equal to this one (same type and size, 1 % tolerance) — by layer: {camadas}. They are selected.
contar.nenhum: There is no object at this point.
